notes.structure: 8 conversion-ordered sections: hero -> problem statement -> 'We close that gap' -> works (SUCCESS STORIES carousel w/ outcome metrics) -> services -> process (3 steps w/ video links) -> FAQ accordion -> CTA -> footer
distinctive: every case study card carries a hard outcome metric (21% conversions, 58% session duration, $100K+ in 30 days)
statistics carousels with prev/next buttons + '0# / 03' counters
'Ask AI about MONOLOG' footer: pre-filled Claude/Gemini/ChatGPT evaluation prompts as a trust mechanism
about modal opened from nav (not a route)
client logo list as social proof band
FAQ answers include pricing transparency ($15k start, $25-50k typical)

notes.display: Animo at up to 205px (SUCCESS STORIES), section heads ~142px
notes.labels: Suisse Mono for meta/labels (SS /05 card markers)
notes.system: 3-face system: expressive display + neutral body + mono metadata

notes.character: bone-on-black editorial; warm grays for hierarchy; no saturated accent — confidence through restraint

notes.library: GSAP 3.15.0 + ScrollTrigger + SplitText + CustomEase + Flip (Webflow CDN), Three.js 0.160.1, Lenis 1.x
signature_effects: cinematic CTA (Awwwards 'Cinematic Call To Action' element)

evidence.method: script inventory (window.gsap present, plugin list) + runtime probe

inferred.claim: Three.js drives a subtle hero/ambient canvas (3 canvases present, one likely WebGL)
SplitText powers the statement hero reveals seen in Awwwards element highlights
inferred.basis: SplitText loaded + Awwwards 'Statement-Driven Hero' element tag

notes.risk: 9 videos on one page need lazy loading; Webflow + jQuery + GSAP stack is heavy
205px display type + video-heavy sections need reduced-motion + AT care; modal focus management unverified

principles.rule: Conversion narrative order: problem -> gap -> proof (metrics) -> process -> objections (FAQ) -> CTA; motion punctuates, never interrupts
Outcome metrics as design elements: numbers (21%, 58%, $100K+) get display-scale treatment — proof is the hero
3-face type system with clear roles: display (Animo) for statements, body (Khteka) for reading, mono (Suisse Mono) for metadata
Radical transparency as trust design: public pricing, real testimonials with names, 'Ask AI about us' links
Warm neutrals only — no accent color; hierarchy from value contrast and type scale, not hue

inferences: Webflow platform means V0 must independently reimplement the choreography (no copying Webflow interactions export)
The 'SS /05' mono markers create an editorial archive feel on commercial work
Video-per-case-study is the richness source; a V0 without media placeholders loses the cinematic quality

anti_patterns.issue: jQuery 3.5.1 still loaded alongside GSAP — legacy Webflow dependency bloat
9 videos + 43 images on one page: heavy without careful lazy-loading
